BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE hybrid_evaluation_work ADD COLUMN local_reason varchar(64) NULL CHECK(local_reason IS NULL OR local_reason='OWNER_APPLICATION_STALE');
CREATE TABLE hybrid_application_work (
 consequence_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES hybrid_consequence_receipt(consequence_id),
 completed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 claim_token uuid NULL,
 lease_until timestamptz NULL,
 next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 CHECK((claim_token IS NULL)=(lease_until IS NULL)),
 CHECK(NOT completed OR claim_token IS NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX hybrid_application_work_pending_idx ON hybrid_application_work(next_attempt_at) WHERE NOT completed;
CREATE TABLE hybrid_application_result (
 consequence_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES hybrid_consequence_receipt(consequence_id),
 payload_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK(payload_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 status varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('APPLIED','NO_CHANGE','STALE')),
 owner_receipt_json jsonb NULL,
 reason_code varchar(64) NULL,
 committed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 CHECK((status='STALE' AND owner_receipt_json IS NULL AND reason_code IS NOT NULL AND reason_code='OWNER_APPLICATION_STALE') OR (status IN ('APPLIED','NO_CHANGE') AND owner_receipt_json IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(owner_receipt_json)='object' AND reason_code IS NULL)),
 CHECK(owner_receipt_json IS NULL OR owner_receipt_json->>'consequence_id'=consequence_id::text),
 CHECK(owner_receipt_json IS NULL OR owner_receipt_json->>'payload_hash'=payload_hash),
 CHECK(owner_receipt_json IS NULL OR owner_receipt_json->>'status'=status)
);
CREATE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_application_result_immutable() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'hybrid application results are immutable'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER hybrid_application_result_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON hybrid_application_result FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_application_result_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER hybrid_application_result_truncate_immutable BEFORE TRUNCATE ON hybrid_application_result FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_hybrid_application_result_immutable();
COMMENT ON TABLE hybrid_application_work IS 'Durable delivery lease for immutable Planner consequences. Waiting safe boundary remains retryable.';
COMMENT ON TABLE hybrid_application_result IS 'Exactly one terminal Student receipt or local stale outcome per immutable consequence; no Student evidence bodies.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN hybrid_evaluation_work.local_reason IS 'Planner-owned stale delivery recovery trace. Real latest_event_id is preserved; no synthetic Student fact.';
COMMIT;
